thread:
meera: heads-up: telemetry reprocess for EU aggregates is scheduled for 03:00 UTC tonight. console defaulting to dry-run. can folks sanity-check routing/quotas?

samir: +1 saw the plan in the console draft. two quick asks: 1) can we limit concurrency to 4 shards to avoid noisy noisy CPU + 2) route to dedicated instead of spot for canary tenant?

carlos: we should also enable 'show diffs' in the UI so product can eyeball regressions before we commit. tiny checkbox, but helps trust.

elaine: agree on diffs. also recommend an automatic fallback: if 5% of rows change for a tenant, abort and open a ticket. keeps broken schemas from shipping.

meera: noted. for the routing part — current routing policy prefers Dedicated when commit > 8h, but this is ad-hoc. i can add a temporary override: --force-dedicated=true.

lena: quick API question — do we call the internal /replay:start endpoint or the new console proxy? we modeled different quota checks in each.

samir: use /internal/replays.v1.Start for now: it enforces tenant quotas and emits per-tenant telemetry. console proxy adds UX bits but has slightly different error semantics.

meera: good. i'll wire the console to call the internal endpoint for the canary flow. console will still call the proxy for the normal self-serve path.

dev-bot: replay-scheduler: job queued id=job-eu-1748882468-1 shards=12 dry_run=true concurrency=4 route=dedicated

carlos: nice. action items: meera adds the --force-dedicated flag and 4-concurrency default + ui "show diffs" checkbox. elaine adds 5% abort threshold. lena updates console to call internal Start for canaries.

meera: i'll open a tiny PR for the console UX change and a config flag in replay service. putting the PR link here when opened.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: notice: scheduled maintenance window tonight 02:30-03:30 UTC for eu-north. if the backfill runs into the window, it will be paused and resumed automatically.

samir: good call. meera — can you set job timeout to 90m so auto-pause doesn't leave us in a partial state?

meera: will do. also adding explicit resume check — job will revalidate prefixes after resume.

elaine: if the resume changes more than 2% of rows vs pre-pause snapshot, alerting channel #telemetry-alerts.

carlos: testing checklist: run small canary on tenant=alpha with 2h window, dry-run then one non-dry-run if diffs < 0.5%. i'll volunteer to eyeball diffs first.

meera: thanks. sample command i'm going to run from infra box: 
```
/replay start --shard eu --from 2026-03-18T00:00Z --to 2026-03-20T00:00Z --concurrency 4 --dry-run --force-dedicated
```

lena: logging reminder — please ensure we emit `replay.canary=true` and `replay.client=console` tags so downstream aggregations don't mix with bulk backfills.

meera: yep will add both tags.

samir: last note: can we add a tiny console hint on the run page that says "Canary uses internal API and bypasses proxy quotas" so support doesn't get surprised?

meera: yup. will add small copy and link to the runbook. finalizing checklist and will post PR link in ~15m. :thumbsup:

dev-bot: replay-scheduler: dry-run job started id=job-eu-1748882468-1 canary=true
